visual_concept.story_function: State the action, knowledge, relationship, tension, or scale change the design makes visible.
visual_concept.design_strategy: State one economical system for delivering that function.
shape_language: State one spatial or formal relationship.
material_language: Describe one relevant surface behavior without inventing a product.
palette: State one color or value role and when it matters.
visual_concept.scale: Separate supplied measurements, relative needs, proposals, and unknown dimensions.
visual_concept.wear: Trace wear or cleanliness to use, exposure, and maintenance; state when none is supported.
visual_concept.cultural_logic: Trace any cultural detail to bounded supplied evidence or label it proposed.
visual_concept.purpose: State why this concept serves the supplied story and coverage.

provenance.basis: Explain the supplied evidence and the new proposal separately.

assets.name: Story-facing environment
assets.purpose: State what action, knowledge, relationship, tension, or orientation this asset enables.

provenance.basis: Trace the asset to a supplied location while keeping new design choices proposed.

design.purpose: State why this proposed or approved treatment serves the supplied asset and shot coverage.

provenance.basis: Separate the supplied asset identity from new form, material, palette, scale, wear, cultural, graphic, or motif decisions.

design.form: State the spatial or object form needed for action and coverage.
materials: Describe required material behavior; keep exact material unconfirmed.
palette_roles: State what the palette must separate, reveal, or preserve.
design.scale: Use relative relationships until dimensions are supplied.
design.wear: State the causally supported wear or intentional absence of wear.
design.cultural_logic: State bounded material or social logic without stereotyping.

practical_digital.rationale: The visible requirement is known; the implementation method is not supplied.
dependencies: Name the departments that must test or decide the method.

coverage.purpose: State why this minimum asset set is required in this shot.

continuity_states.entry_state: State the observable condition at the start.
continuity_states.exit_state: State the observable condition after the action.
continuity_states.reset_to: State the exact condition required for another take.
reset_actions: State one observable restoration or verification action.
continuity_states.purpose: State the causal or matching reason this state matters.

cross_department_dependencies.need: State the design behavior another department must test or preserve.
cross_department_dependencies.purpose: State why this handoff matters to story, coverage, or continuity.

assumptions: State provisional design and implementation choices, or leave this array empty.
uncertainties: State missing facts, dimensions, materials, methods, approvals, or upstream decisions.
